question: Under this policy, will I pay a withdrawal charge?

calls.content:
- Yes, a cash value withdrawal is currently subject to a withdrawal charge of US$25, HK$200, or MOP200 each time [S2].
- The withdrawal charge is waived if you use the automatic periodic withdrawal option [S2].
- The automatic periodic withdrawal option is available only if the policy has been in force for at least 10 years [S4].
- A surrender charge is separate and may apply in the first 14 years on lapse, surrender, or decrease in Basic Sum Insured [S2].
